experiment: P3.2c: time-dependent energy and service ledger. Daily site energy and service of the 3.5/7.2 GHz network over the ETSI day, for time-of-day activation schedules, on the unchanged P3.2b traffic layer (run 2, result of record) and the unchanged P3.1 energy models; P3.0 revision 4 (D20-D26)

criteria.all_user: primary (D21): outage share over all users, a not-admitted user counted in outage; DL and UL each <= epsilon in every level with traffic
criteria.admitted: registered P3.2b criterion (D17): pooled outage of admitted users; DL and UL each <= epsilon in every level with traffic
criteria.dl_only_all_user: the UL-agnostic evaluation: the all-user DL criterion alone

service.identity: out_all = n + (1 - n) out_adm, n = not-admitted share

day.source: ETSI ES 202 706-1 V1.7.1 clause 7 Table 3 default durations 6 / 10 / 8 h (low = SSB + RMSI only, D18); the chronological order is an assumption

hardware.m_rf_label: service architecture not matched (D3): radio of M_RF 256

layer_3p5.load: 3.5 GHz DL realized occupancy (time-domain load N_a/N); no UL-load term

hardware.layer_7p2_loads: (L_7.2,DL, L_7.2,UL) realized occupancies; L_7.2,UL = 0 for a DL-only carrier

S1.rule: P_misc / eta_afe + P_link / eta_dbb with Golard's AAU misc AFE P_misc = p_misc_ref (N_PA P_max / P*)^alpha12 and link-layer baseband P_link = p_link_ref / N_C^alpha3, N_C = 1; Golard values from the P3.1 config (golard_table2); eta = eta_supply x eta_cool

S2.rule: P_aux = P_3.5(load 0, case right) - P_empty,7.2 of the hardware point (no-load parity with the measured 3.5 GHz radio)

overhead.state_rule: P_aux in every in-frame state and in activation intervals; sleep anchor P_mu + P_aux; light/deep powers and E_add by the TR ratios of the adjusted anchor (D11)

sleep.35only: 7.2 GHz held in deep sleep all day: deep-sleep power, no transition, no E_add

wake.proactive: the schedule issues the wake request T_TR + T_SCell before the level boundary (a time-of-day rule; no traffic information)
wake.reactive: the request is issued at the level boundary; until the SCell is active the level's traffic is carried by the 3.5-GHz-only state (gap seconds reported, violations flagged per criterion)
wake.availability: a sleeping cell is unavailable for the full T_TR after the request (D4 primary)
wake.activation_interval: after T_TR the 7.2 GHz cell is on and empty (P_empty + P_aux) for T_SCell, serving nothing

scell_activation.rule: unknown FR1 SCell, inter-band: T_activation = T_FirstSSB_MAX + T_SMTC_MAX + 2 T_rs + T_delta + 5 ms <= 4 P + 5 ms (SMTC period P; T_delta = 0); T_HARQ + T_CSI_reporting allowed one period P (assumption): T_SCell = 5 P + 5 ms
scell_activation.label: FR1 requirement applied to 7.2 GHz (above 7.125 GHz; no FR3 requirement exists): extrapolation

policy_labels.ulsel: 7.2 GHz UL enabled (UL carrier selection, D20)
policy_labels.bound: optimistic bound: zero transition time, zero E_add, zero T_SCell; never a deployable result

sustainable_growth: g* of a policy = min over levels with traffic of x*_both(state of the level) / f, f = 1 (busy) or x_30 (medium); x*_both = min(x*_DL, x*_UL(y) / rho); per criterion; DL-only view uses x*_DL alone

gates.E0_provenance: P3.1, P3.2a, P3.2b manifests all_checks_passed and equal to the hashes above; P3.2b and P3.1 configs equal their manifest hashes; P3.2b and P3.1 outputs equal their manifest hashes; code constants equal this config
gates.E1_power_reproduction: 3.5 GHz (both cases, six loads), 7.2 GHz (the three hardware points and the three M_RF energy-only points: eight load pairs, P_mu, P_empty, ladders cat1/cat2 x set1/set3: p, T, E_add) equal P3.1's summary to <= 1e-12 relative; S2's 7.2 GHz no-load power equals P_3.5(0) to <= 1e-12 relative
gates.E2_p32b_reproduction: bitwise equal to P3.2b run 2 for ISD 200, C: calibration T_0.3 and T_0.5; every raw L and rho array on P3.2b's grids (DL off/on at 0, -3, -10 dB; UL off, on_ulca, on_scell_dl); every admitted-user x* (DL off/on at three offsets, UL off and on_ulca)
gates.E3_new_levels: fixed points converged (residual <= 1e-9); closure <= 1e-12 relative; occupancy identity <= 1e-9; 0 <= L <= 1; offered per-user workload bitwise identical across states; loads non-decreasing in traffic; zero traffic gives L = 0
gates.E4_all_user: |out_all - (n + (1 - n) out_adm)| <= 1e-12 at every level and state; all-user x* <= admitted x*; out_all non-decreasing in traffic
gates.E5_ledger: per policy and scenario: 7.2 GHz intervals cover 86400 s once (<= 1e-9 s); energy equals P3.1 sequence_energy on the cell-mean powers (<= 1e-12 relative); every sleep >= its T; one E_add per sleep period; zero 7.2 GHz service outside on intervals
gates.E6_causality: decisions depend on the time of day only: with the traffic after each boundary doubled, every decision before it is unchanged; reactive requests never precede the traffic change
gates.E7_overhead: E(S0) < E(S1) < E(S2) for every policy with a 7.2 GHz cell; E(S1) - E(S0) equals an independent sum of P_aux increments (<= 1e-9 relative)
gates.E8_toy_fixtures: two-level toy day 374403 J (no activation) and 374451 J (1 s activation at 50 W); a sleep shorter than T rejected; reactive gap exactly T_TR + T_SCell

predictions.E_P1_offload_near_neutral_S0: ISD 200, C, 50 dBm, M_RF 256, 3.5 GHz right, cat1, proactive: at g = 1 and 10/90, 0.90 <= mean busy-level site power(aon_ulsel) / mean busy-level site power(35only) <= 1.10 (35only includes the 7.2 GHz deep-sleep power)
predictions.E_P3_low_period_sleep: 1 - E(sch_medbusy_ulsel) / E(aon_ulsel) (daily site energy) at every g of the grid where both are all-user-feasible, both mixes: in [0.03, 0.08] under S0 and >= 0.10 under S2

expectations_not_scored.transitions_negligible: E_add plus activation-interval energy < 0.1 % of the 7.2 GHz layer's daily energy for every schedule, scenario, category and wake mode
expectations_not_scored.dl_all_user_equals_admitted: no DL user is unadmitted at ISD 200, so the DL all-user x* equals the admitted x*
expectations_not_scored.ai_era_today: at 26/74 and g = 1, 35only and every DL-only policy are all-user-infeasible (from P3.2b x*_UL(off) = 0.901; a consequence, not a test)

decision_rules.all_gates_pass: P3.2c's energy mapping, state machine and ledger are the energy layer of P3.3; the all-user criterion is P3.3's primary service constraint; P3.3's controllers are compared with the minimum-energy all-user-feasible P3.2c schedule at each g; if E-P1 and E-P2 both hold, the busy-hour energy case of 7.2 GHz is reported as overhead-dependent (H4) and P3.3 reports S0-S2 for every result
decision_rules.gate_fails: stop; keep the evidence; amendment before any rerun

declared_before_registration: Every P3.1 and P3.2b output (both P3.2b runs) and TS 38.133 clause 8.3.2 were read before registration.

Hand estimates while designing the predictions, from P3.1's tables and an assumed busy-hour 7.2 GHz DL load of about 0.15 (no P3.2c output computed): E-P1 ratio about 0.97, S2 ratio about 1.5, low-period sleep saving about 4.5 % (S0) and 12 % (S2); S1 at the primary point 172.0 W.
Unit tests: 14 (hand-checkable fixtures); full suite passing.

One smoke run (--smoke-realizations 2, scratch folder, 26 s): every gate E0-E8 computable and passing (E2 code path only: no 2-realization reference); overall verdict forced FAIL by the smoke flag; no result values printed; output files not opened.
A key-existence check of E2's P3.2b inputs (26 raw arrays of shapes (9, 300) and (18, 300), 8 x* entries); no new result computed.
